python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Original debt values (millions)
debt_1992 = 144724
debt_1993 = 158633
debt_1994 = 166731

# CPI-U annual averages
cpi_1992 = 140.3
cpi_1993 = 144.5
cpi_1994 = 148.2

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars: adjusted = original * (CPI_1994 / CPI_year)
adj_1992 = debt_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
adj_1993 = debt_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
adj_1994 = debt_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)  # This is just the original value

print("Inflation-adjusted values (constant 1994 dollars, millions):")
print(f"1992: {adj_1992:.2f}")
print(f"1993: {adj_1993:.2f}")
print(f"1994: {adj_1994:.2f}")

# Calculate sample mean
n = 3
values = [adj_1992, adj_1993, adj_1994]
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.2f}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation (using n-1)
# Sample variance = sum((x - mean)^2) / (n-1)
# Sample std = sqrt(sample variance)
squared_diffs = [(v - mean)**2 for v in values]
sample_variance = sum(squared_diffs) / (n - 1)
sample_std = math.sqrt(sample_variance)
print(f"Sample Std Dev (n-1): {sample_std:.2f}")

# Calculate z-score for 1994
z_score = (adj_1994 - mean) / sample_std
print(f"\nZ-score for 1994: {z_score:.2f}")

# Round to 2 decimal places
print(f"\nFinal z-score (rounded): {round(z_score, 2)}")
EOF
